info.title: Swoovr waitlist
info.description: Same-origin encrypted PostgreSQL signup. No automatic email or ownership confirmation. Referrals are recorded without validation or access entitlements.

post.summary: Submit an email and permission for launch updates
post.description: Same-origin application/json only; maximum 4096 bytes. Validates adult declaration and specific marketing consent. Encrypts personal fields before PostgreSQL insert. Deduplicates email using a secret HMAC. Existing records, including suppression and first referral, remain unchanged. Generates a private random share code, not returned or emailed. A populated honeypot is silently discarded. No sensitive data enters analytics.

website.description: Honeypot; normal clients send an empty string.

referralCode.description: Optional; recorded only. Not checked or redeemed.

202.description: Database accepted insert or existing registration, or honeypot discarded. Body {ok:true}. Does not confirm ownership or grant access.

400.description: Invalid JSON, email or consent. Body: {ok:false,error:string}.

405.description: Method other than POST; Allow: POST.

502.description: Database operation unconfirmed. Retrying is deduplicated by email.

503.description: Missing/invalid database or encryption configuration, or limiter unavailable.
